scope: R11 Owner explicit notification geometry, input-safe bar, own/HOME scene and Uperf eligibility, desired Monitor reconnect; GPU exclusions retained

daemon.before:
esac
    case "$1" in /data/app/?*.apk|/system/preinstall/?*.apk) return 0 ;; esac
    return 1
}
daemon.after:
esac
    case "$1" in /data/app/?*.apk|/system/preinstall/?*.apk) return 0 ;; esac
    if [ "${2:-0}" = 1 ]; then
        case "$1" in /system/app/?*.apk|/system/priv-app/?*.apk) return 0 ;; esac
    fi
    return 1
}

daemon.before:
package_is_user_app() (
    valid_package_name "$1" || return 1
    case "$1" in android|com.android.systemui|com.zui.zuicontrol) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$1" in *.*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    paths="$(timeout 5 pm path --user current "$1" </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
    [ -n "$paths" ] || return 1
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        case "$line" in package:*) apk="${line#package:}" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
        uperf_apk_path_allowed "$apk" || return 1
        [ -f "$apk" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$apk" 2>/dev/null)" = "$apk" ] || return 1
    done <<EOF_UPERF_PATHS
$paths
EOF_UPERF_PATHS
    launch="$(timeout 5 cmd package resolve-activity --user current -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -p "$1" </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
    printf '%s\n' "$launch" | uperf_launchable_query_allowed "$1"
)
daemon.after:
package_is_user_app() (
    valid_package_name "$1" || return 1
    case "$1" in android|com.android.systemui) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$1" in *.*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    # Only our launchable App and the actual resolved HOME may use system App roots.
    qualified_system_scene=0
    home="$(timeout 5 cmd package resolve-activity --user current -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
    if printf '%s\n' "$home" | uperf_launchable_query_allowed "$1"; then
        qualified_system_scene=1
        launch="$home"
    else
        launch="$(timeout 5 cmd package resolve-activity --user current -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -p "$1" </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
        [ "$1" != com.zui.zuicontrol ] || qualified_system_scene=1
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$launch" | uperf_launchable_query_allowed "$1" || return 1
    paths="$(timeout 5 pm path --user current "$1" </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
    [ -n "$paths" ] || return 1
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        case "$line" in package:*) apk="${line#package:}" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
        uperf_apk_path_allowed "$apk" "$qualified_system_scene" || return 1
        [ -f "$apk" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$apk" 2>/dev/null)" = "$apk" ] || return 1
    done <<EOF_UPERF_PATHS
$paths
EOF_UPERF_PATHS
    return 0
)

service.before:
return p.equals("com.android.systemui")
                || p.equals(GAME_HELPER_PACKAGE)
                || p.equals(APP_PACKAGE)
                || p.equals(SCREEN_SPLIT_CONTROL_PACKAGE)
                || p.equals(FREEFORM_SIDEBAR_PACKAGE)
